impact_summary.value: 고위험 원료의 각 입고 로트에서 유해 불순물을 검출하는 동일성 시험이 입증되지 않아 원료의 제조 투입 적합성을 보증하지 못했습니다. 오염 성분은 치명적 중독 사례와 관련된다고 서한은 설명합니다.

evidence.quote: Because you did not perform identity testing on each shipment of each lot using the USP identification test that detects these hazardous impurities, you failed to assure the acceptability of these components for use in manufacture of your drug products.

affected_work.value: 선스크린 등을 제조하는 데 쓰이는 글리세린 등 고위험 성분의 입고 로트 시험, 자재 시스템과 외부 시험기관 관리, 품질부서의 자재 승인·거부 및 제조 전반의 품질 감독이 영향을 받습니다.

evidence.quote: You manufacture several over-the-counter (OTC) drug products, including (b)(4) , (b)(4) , (b)(4) , and sunscreen. Based on the records and information you provided, you did not demonstrate that you adequately tested each shipment of each lot of the incoming components at high-risk of diethylene glycol (DEG) or ethylene glycol (EG) contamination. These include, but are not limited to, testing of glycerin

recommendation.value: FDA는 고위험 성분 보관검체 시험 결과와 유효기간 내 관련 제품의 위험평가를 제출하고, 오염 가능 원료 및 제품의 안전성을 확인해 오염 로트에 고객 통지와 회수를 포함한 조치를 하라고 요구합니다. 각 원료 로트 시험 및 COA 검증, 자재 시스템 검토, 계약 시험기관 관리 요약, 품질부서 개선 계획도 답변에 포함하도록 요구합니다.

evidence.quote: A commitment to provide DEG and EG test results, no later than 30 calendar days from the date of this letter, from testing retains for all lots of high-risk drug components used in the manufacture of drug products. Alternatively, if a retain of a component lot is unavailable, perform retain sample testing of all implicated finished drug product batches for the presence of DEG and EG.

A summary of your program for qualifying and overseeing contract facilities that test the drug products you manufacture. A summary of results obtained from testing all components to evaluate the reliability of the COA from each component manufacturer.
A comprehensive assessment and remediation plan to ensure your QU is given the authority and resources to effectively function.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 30 working days.
